properties.description: Response to flo2's "853 edges gained a field" (2026-09-14), root-caused as an older release binary (0.59.0, served by the launcher) importing/writing a record a newer reflow2 (0.60.2) had written: import compared no versions, the open-time guard compared only vocabulary, and the old binary's `role: author` default landed on 853 AUTHORED_BY edges in silence. Anthony's word: "yes on three-leg fix". Ordering: after the v0.61.1 cut (499). MUST NOT: refuse an OLDER document (additive, reads whole); refuse on vocabulary the guard already handles; hide the materialized counts on a same-version import (they are the defaults the export left implicit on purpose, and saying so is the point). Tests were written together with the fix, not failing-first; the mcp suite, core suite, clippy and smoke are green on the branch.
properties.name: An import knows its own age (2026-09-15)
